# RustUse

RustUse provides composable sets of primitive Rust utility crates.

Primary site: https://rustuse.org/
Onboarding docs: https://rustuse.org/onboarding/
Crate docs overview: https://rustuse.org/crates/
Set docs overview: https://rustuse.org/sets/
API reference: https://rustuse.org/api-reference/
Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-math/

Current core crates:
- use-math
- use-geometry
- use-combinatorics

Key crate pages:
- https://rustuse.org/use-math/
- https://rustuse.org/use-geometry/
- https://rustuse.org/use-math/use-combinatorics/

Key API pages:
- https://rustuse.org/api/use-math/
- https://rustuse.org/api/use-geometry/
- https://rustuse.org/api/use-combinatorics/
